citations.claim: total energy at first violating step has drifted far from initial value
energy was still near initial value 3 steps earlier while pair was wider

counterfactual.change: reduced dt from 0.013813493909744793 to 0.005 keeping all bodies, G, seed and steps identical; finer timestep resolves the close encounter and removes the violation

explanation: Bodies 0 and 1 (m~12.6 and ~10.9) undergo a close encounter: separation shrinks from 0.96 at step 150 to 0.53 at step 153, comparable to softening 0.3, so accelerations and velocities spike (speeds ~8.6 and ~10.5, kinetic ~1111, |potential| ~1262). Substeps per outer step saturate at 10 (8 at step 150, 10 at step 153), i.e. the adaptive substepping is capped and cannot fully resolve the stiff encounter at dt~0.0138, so leapfrog energy error accumulates and total energy drifts from ~-86 to ~-151.5, exceeding the 2% tolerance. Halving dt removes the failure.
vision_note: The two upper bodies approach each other along curved trails from step 150 to 152 and then overlap into contact at step 153. A third lower body stays well separated and nearly stationary throughout.
